summary_en: Helkomine revived the withdrawn EIP-2711 idea: let others pay fees while keeping the original sender address, which even EIP-7702 does not solve. peter_szilagyi added composite ML-DSA-65 plus Ed25519 signatures and ML-KEM-768 plus X25519 encryption to his Rust crypto library. mudgen's simplified Diamonds ERC merged.
